requests.prompt: App icon for an Android multi-plan time management app called Wake Plan. Design language: deep dark navy background color #0B1426 with rounded square shape and soft inner glow. Centered composition: a clean circular clock face with 12 hour tick dots around the perimeter, all dots fully inside the icon safe area with no clipping at edges. The 12 hour dots: most are small amber #F5A524 dots, but three dots at the 2 o'clock, 6 o'clock and 10 o'clock positions are larger colored dots with a glow halo in plan colors: pink #EC4899, sky blue #3B82F6, mint green #10B981. Center of the clock has warm amber hour and minute hands pointing to roughly 10:10. Soft inner glow on the clock face gives subtle volumetric depth. The clock face takes about 70 percent of the icon area, leaving comfortable dark navy margin between the dots and the icon edge. Style: clean modern dark theme, premium productivity app aesthetic. High quality, professional, production ready. Pure white background outside the icon. Front-facing view, straight on. No text, no labels, no watermarks, icon only, isolated.
